soalan: Read this note: 'A balanced diet should include plenty of fruit and vegetables every day.' According to the note, what should a balanced diet include plenty of?
maklum_balas: The text states a balanced diet should include plenty of fruit and vegetables.

soalan: 'The soup was too bland, so Aina added more salt and pepper.' The word 'bland' most likely means the soup had little _____.
maklum_balas: Adding salt and pepper for taste shows 'bland' means lacking flavour.

soalan: Choose the correctly spelled word to complete the sentence: 'Fresh vegetables are full of important _____.'
maklum_balas: The correct spelling is 'nutrients'.

soalan: Choose the sentence with correct punctuation.
pilihan: Do you prefer grilled fish or fried chicken?
Do you prefer grilled fish or fried chicken.
do you prefer grilled fish or fried chicken?
Do you prefer, grilled fish or fried chicken
maklum_balas: A question needs a capital letter at the start and a question mark at the end.

soalan: Read: 'The canteen now serves brown rice instead of white rice to make meals healthier.' What change did the canteen make?
pilihan: It serves brown rice instead of white rice
It added more sugar to meals
maklum_balas: The text clearly states the canteen replaced white rice with brown rice.

soalan: Read this paragraph: 'Skipping breakfast may seem like a good way to save time, but it often leaves students tired and unable to concentrate in class. A simple, healthy breakfast gives the body energy for the morning.' What is the main idea?
pilihan: Eating a healthy breakfast helps students stay energetic and focused
Students should always skip breakfast to save time
Breakfast is the least important meal of the day
Students concentrate better when they are tired
maklum_balas: The paragraph's main idea is that a healthy breakfast provides energy and focus.

soalan: 'It is truly worrying how many teenagers now rely on sugary snacks instead of proper meals.' What is the writer's attitude towards teenagers eating sugary snacks?
maklum_balas: The phrase 'truly worrying' shows the writer feels concerned.

soalan: During a talk on smart eating, which sentence best explains an advantage of cooking meals at home?
pilihan: You can control the amount of salt and oil you use
It always costs much more than eating out
It removes all the flavour from food
maklum_balas: Cooking at home lets you control ingredients such as salt and oil, which is an advantage.

soalan: A pie chart shows students' lunch choices: 50% rice meals, 30% sandwiches, 20% instant noodles. Which statement correctly explains the chart?
pilihan: Half of the students chose rice meals
Sandwiches were the most popular choice
maklum_balas: 50% means half of the students chose rice meals, the largest group.

soalan: 'Processed foods are often high in additives, which are substances added to preserve or flavour them.' Based on the context, an 'additive' is something that is _____.
maklum_balas: The definition in the sentence explains an additive is a substance added to food.

soalan: A nutritionist says: 'Try to drink at least eight glasses of water a day, especially in hot weather.' How many glasses of water does she recommend?
maklum_balas: The speaker recommends at least eight glasses of water a day.

soalan: A writer argues: 'Labelling junk food as a treat teaches children that unhealthy eating is a reward, a lesson that can last a lifetime.' What can be inferred about the writer's view?
pilihan: The writer believes calling junk food a treat encourages poor lifelong habits
The writer thinks junk food is the best reward for children
The writer feels food labels have no effect on children
The writer supports giving children junk food daily
maklum_balas: The writer implies that framing junk food as a treat shapes harmful long-term attitudes.

soalan: In a debate on banning sugary drinks in schools, which response best justifies a point of view?
pilihan: I think they should be banned because they raise the risk of obesity and tooth decay among students
I just don't like them and that is enough
They should stay because I say so
Banning them is a bad idea, but I cannot explain why
maklum_balas: A justified view gives a clear reason, here linking sugary drinks to health risks.

soalan: Which sentence best explains a cause and its consequence in the context of smart eating?
pilihan: Because he ate too much fast food, his energy levels dropped and he gained weight
He ate fast food and the weather was cold
Fast food is sold in many places around town
He enjoys eating out with his friends on weekends
maklum_balas: Option A links a cause (eating too much fast food) to its consequences (low energy and weight gain).

soalan: Read: 'Regular exercise and enough sleep are two simple ways to stay well.' According to the text, which two things help you stay well?
pilihan: Skipping meals and staying up late
Watching television and resting all day
maklum_balas: The text names regular exercise and enough sleep as ways to stay well.

soalan: 'After the flu, she felt weak, but a week of rest helped her recover fully.' The word 'recover' means to _____.
maklum_balas: Resting after illness to feel well again shows 'recover' means to get better.

soalan: Choose the correctly spelled word: 'Washing your hands helps to prevent the spread of _____.'
maklum_balas: The correct spelling is 'germs'.

soalan: Choose the sentence with correct punctuation.
pilihan: My doctor said, 'Get plenty of rest and drink water.'
my doctor said get plenty of rest and drink water
My doctor said Get plenty of rest and drink water
My doctor said, get plenty of rest and drink water
maklum_balas: Direct speech needs a capital letter, quotation marks and correct end punctuation.

soalan: Read: 'The clinic offers free health checks every Monday morning.' When are the free health checks offered?
maklum_balas: The text states the free health checks are offered every Monday morning.

soalan: Read: 'Prevention is often better than cure. Simple habits like eating well, staying active and sleeping enough can stop many illnesses before they start.' What is the main idea?
pilihan: Healthy daily habits can help prevent illness
Medicine is the only way to stay healthy
Illness cannot be avoided at all
maklum_balas: The main idea is that good daily habits prevent illness before it begins.

soalan: 'Sadly, too many people ignore the early warning signs their bodies give them.' What is the writer's opinion about people ignoring warning signs?
pilihan: The writer is proud of it
maklum_balas: The word 'sadly' shows the writer disapproves.

soalan: Which sentence best explains a cause and consequence about wellness?
pilihan: Because she exercised regularly, her heart grew stronger
She exercised and later bought new shoes
Exercise is popular among many teenagers today
She prefers jogging to swimming in the morning
maklum_balas: Option A links a cause (regular exercise) to a consequence (a stronger heart).

soalan: A friend tells you she has recovered from a long illness. Which reply best expresses a positive feeling?
pilihan: I am so relieved and happy that you are well again
That is none of my business
You should not have been ill
I do not care about your health
maklum_balas: Option A appropriately expresses relief and happiness at good news.

soalan: 'A balanced lifestyle boosts your immunity, the body's natural defence against disease.' Based on the context, 'immunity' means the body's ability to _____.
maklum_balas: The sentence defines immunity as the body's natural defence against disease.

soalan: A writer states: 'We spend fortunes treating illnesses that a few good habits could have prevented in the first place.' What is the writer suggesting?
pilihan: Preventing illness through good habits would save money and suffering
Treating illness is always cheaper than preventing it
Good habits have no link to health
People should spend more on treatment than prevention
maklum_balas: The writer implies prevention through good habits is wiser than costly treatment.

soalan: In a story, an author writes: 'Her cough echoed through the silent, shadowed ward.' What effect does this description mainly create?
pilihan: A tense, lonely and gloomy atmosphere
A sense of comedy and fun
maklum_balas: Words like 'silent', 'shadowed' and 'echoed' build a tense, lonely and gloomy atmosphere.

soalan: In a discussion on health, which statement best explains and justifies a point of view?
pilihan: Schools should teach wellness because students who learn healthy habits early stay healthier as adults
Schools should teach wellness, full stop
I don't think wellness matters, but I can't say why
Health lessons are boring so they should be removed
maklum_balas: Option A states a view and justifies it with a clear reason.

soalan: A health talk states: 'Adults should aim for about seven to eight hours of sleep each night for good health.' How many hours of sleep are recommended?
maklum_balas: The speaker recommends about seven to eight hours of sleep each night.

soalan: Read: 'Volunteers cleaned the river and planted trees along the bank.' What did the volunteers plant?
maklum_balas: The text states the volunteers planted trees along the bank.

soalan: 'The whole neighbourhood came together to support the flood victims.' The word 'support' here means to _____.
maklum_balas: Coming together for flood victims shows 'support' means to help.

soalan: Choose the correctly spelled word: 'Many people gave their time to _____ work at the shelter.'
maklum_balas: The correct spelling is 'voluntary'.

soalan: Choose the sentence with correct punctuation.
pilihan: We collected food, clothes and books for the shelter.
We collected food clothes and books for the shelter
we collected food, clothes and books for the shelter
We collected food, clothes and books for the shelter?
maklum_balas: Items in a list need commas and the sentence needs a full stop.

soalan: Read: 'The community centre offers free tuition to children from low-income families.' Who receives the free tuition?
maklum_balas: The text states free tuition is offered to children from low-income families.

soalan: Read: 'When people give a little of their time to help others, whole communities grow stronger. Small acts of service, repeated by many, create lasting change.' What is the main idea?
pilihan: Small acts of service by many people can strengthen communities
Only large donations can help a community
maklum_balas: The main idea is that many small acts of service together strengthen communities.

soalan: 'It is inspiring to see young people give up their weekends to help the elderly.' What is the writer's attitude towards these young people?
maklum_balas: The word 'inspiring' shows the writer admires the young people.

soalan: Which sentence best explains a cause and consequence in a community project?
pilihan: Because residents recycled more, the amount of rubbish in the area fell sharply
Residents recycled and the shop had a sale
Recycling bins come in different colours
The project was held on a sunny afternoon
maklum_balas: Option A links a cause (more recycling) to a consequence (less rubbish).

soalan: Which sentence best explains the main point of an argument for community service?
pilihan: Community service benefits everyone by building trust and cooperation among neighbours
Some people wear gloves when they help
The project started at nine in the morning
maklum_balas: Option A clearly states the central point of the argument.

soalan: 'The charity relies on donations, the money and goods people give freely to help others.' Based on the context, a 'donation' is something that is _____.
maklum_balas: The sentence defines a donation as money or goods given freely to help others.

soalan: A writer states: 'A society is judged not by its wealth, but by how it treats its most vulnerable members.' What is the writer mainly arguing?
pilihan: Caring for the vulnerable matters more than being rich
Wealth is the only measure of a good society
Money always makes a society fair
maklum_balas: The writer argues that how a society treats its weakest members matters more than its wealth.

soalan: In a debate on making community service compulsory for students, which response best justifies a point of view?
pilihan: It should be compulsory because it teaches students empathy and responsibility they will carry into adulthood
It should be compulsory just because other schools do it
It should not happen and I cannot explain why
Community service is a waste of time for everyone
maklum_balas: Option A states a view and supports it with a reasoned justification.

soalan: Which sentence best explains both the cause and consequence of a successful clean-up campaign?
pilihan: Because hundreds of residents joined the clean-up, the park became safer and more pleasant to use
The clean-up campaign had a colourful banner
Residents talked about the weather during the event
The campaign was mentioned briefly on the radio
maklum_balas: Option A links the cause (mass participation) to the consequence (a safer, nicer park).

soalan: Read: 'Sara saves ten ringgit from her pocket money every week.' How much does Sara save each week?
maklum_balas: The text states Sara saves ten ringgit every week.
topic: Unit 10: A Penny Saved is a Penny Earned

soalan: 'He kept his savings in a jar until he had enough to buy a bicycle.' The word 'savings' means money that is _____.
maklum_balas: Keeping money in a jar to buy something later shows 'savings' means money kept for later use.
topic: Unit 10: A Penny Saved is a Penny Earned

soalan: Choose the correctly spelled word: 'Writing a monthly _____ helps you track your spending.'
maklum_balas: The correct spelling is 'budget'.
topic: Unit 10: A Penny Saved is a Penny Earned

soalan: Choose the sentence with correct punctuation.
pilihan: If you save regularly, you will have money for emergencies.
If you save regularly you will have money for emergencies
if you save regularly, you will have money for emergencies
If you save regularly; you will have money for emergencies?
maklum_balas: A comma is needed after the opening clause and a full stop at the end.
topic: Unit 10: A Penny Saved is a Penny Earned

soalan: Read: 'The bank pays interest on money kept in a savings account.' What does the bank pay on savings?
maklum_balas: The text states the bank pays interest on savings.
topic: Unit 10: A Penny Saved is a Penny Earned

soalan: Read: 'Saving small amounts regularly may feel slow, but over time these little sums grow into a useful fund for the future.' What is the main idea?
pilihan: Saving small amounts regularly builds up over time
Saving is only worthwhile in large amounts
It is impossible to save small sums
maklum_balas: The main idea is that regular small savings grow into a useful amount over time.
topic: Unit 10: A Penny Saved is a Penny Earned

soalan: A bar chart shows monthly savings: January RM20, February RM40, March RM60. Which statement correctly explains the chart?
pilihan: Savings increased steadily from January to March
Savings stayed the same every month
No money was saved in March
maklum_balas: The rising figures show savings increased steadily each month.
topic: Unit 10: A Penny Saved is a Penny Earned

soalan: 'Try to cut down on unnecessary expenses, the things you buy but do not really need.' Based on the context, 'expenses' are _____.
maklum_balas: The sentence explains expenses are things you buy or spend money on.
topic: Unit 10: A Penny Saved is a Penny Earned

soalan: A speaker advises: 'Set aside at least ten per cent of your income before you spend anything else.' How much does she suggest setting aside first?
pilihan: At least ten per cent of your income
maklum_balas: The speaker suggests saving at least ten per cent of income first.
topic: Unit 10: A Penny Saved is a Penny Earned

soalan: 'It is disappointing that so few young people bother to save any money at all.' What is the writer's attitude?
maklum_balas: The word 'disappointing' shows the writer is disappointed.
topic: Unit 10: A Penny Saved is a Penny Earned

soalan: Which sentence best explains a cause and its consequence about saving money?
pilihan: Because she saved a little every month, she could pay for the repair without borrowing
She saved money and the shop repainted its walls
Saving money is a common topic in magazines
She keeps her coins in a bright red tin
maklum_balas: Option A links the cause (regular saving) to the consequence (paying without borrowing).
topic: Unit 10: A Penny Saved is a Penny Earned

soalan: A writer states: 'The habit of saving is not about how much you earn, but about the discipline to spend less than you have.' What is the writer mainly suggesting?
pilihan: Self-discipline matters more than income when it comes to saving
Only high earners can ever save money
Spending more than you earn is wise
Income is the only thing that affects saving
maklum_balas: The writer implies discipline in spending, not income size, is the key to saving.
topic: Unit 10: A Penny Saved is a Penny Earned

soalan: Which sentence best explains the main point of an argument in favour of budgeting?
pilihan: Budgeting gives people control over their money by showing exactly where it goes
Budgeting means writing numbers in a book
Some people budget on a phone app
Budgets can be drawn in different colours
maklum_balas: Option A states the central argument that budgeting gives control over money.
topic: Unit 10: A Penny Saved is a Penny Earned

soalan: Read: 'Always keep your receipt in case you need to return the item.' Why should you keep your receipt?
pilihan: In case you need to return the item
To give it to a friend
maklum_balas: The text states you should keep the receipt in case you need to return the item.

soalan: 'The shop offered a discount, so the shoes cost less than usual.' The word 'discount' means a _____ in price.
maklum_balas: Costing less than usual shows a discount is a reduction in price.

soalan: Choose the correctly spelled word: 'A smart shopper always compares prices before making a _____.'
maklum_balas: The correct spelling is 'purchase'.

soalan: You are writing a formal complaint letter to a shop. Which greeting is most appropriate?
maklum_balas: 'Dear Sir or Madam,' is the correct formal greeting for a complaint letter.

soalan: Read: 'Consumers have the right to safe products and honest information.' According to the text, what is one right consumers have?
pilihan: The right to pay no money
The right to take goods for free
maklum_balas: The text lists honest information as one of the consumers' rights.

soalan: Read: 'Being money smart means thinking before you buy. Ask whether you truly need an item, whether you can afford it, and whether it is good value.' What is the main idea?
pilihan: Smart shoppers think carefully before buying
Smart shoppers buy everything they see
Shopping should be done without thinking
maklum_balas: The main idea is that being money smart means thinking carefully before buying.

soalan: You are speaking politely to a shop manager about a faulty product. Which sentence uses an appropriately formal register?
pilihan: Excuse me, I would like to report a problem with this item, please.
Oi, this thing is broken, sort it out now!
This junk is rubbish, give me my cash back!
Yo, your stuff is useless, mate.
maklum_balas: Option A uses polite, formal language suitable for speaking to a manager.

soalan: 'Beware of impulse buying, purchasing something suddenly without planning to.' Based on the context, 'impulse buying' means buying something _____.
maklum_balas: The sentence defines impulse buying as purchasing suddenly without planning.

soalan: 'Shockingly, some advertisements deliberately mislead shoppers to make a quick sale.' What is the writer's attitude towards these advertisements?
maklum_balas: The word 'shockingly' shows the writer disapproves of misleading advertisements.

soalan: Which sentence best explains a disadvantage of buying goods on credit?
pilihan: You may end up paying much more because of the added interest
You always pay far less than the cash price
There is never any risk of debt
Credit removes the need to repay anything
maklum_balas: Paying extra interest is a clear disadvantage of buying on credit.

soalan: A writer states: 'A bargain is only a bargain if it is something you actually needed in the first place.' What is the writer mainly suggesting?
pilihan: Cheap prices do not save money if you buy things you do not need
Every discounted item is worth buying
Needing an item is unimportant when shopping
Bargains always save money no matter what
maklum_balas: The writer implies a low price is not a real saving unless the item was needed.

soalan: In a talk on consumer rights, which response best explains and justifies a point of view?
pilihan: Shops should give clear refunds because fair treatment builds customers' trust and loyalty
Shops should give refunds just because customers ask
Refunds are a bad idea, but I cannot say why
Consumer rights do not matter to anyone
maklum_balas: Option A states a view and justifies it with a reasoned explanation.

soalan: Which sentence best explains a cause and its consequence about smart spending?
pilihan: Because he compared prices at several shops, he saved twenty ringgit on the same phone
He compared prices and the weather turned cloudy
Many shops in town sell the same phone
He likes shopping with his cousin on Sundays
maklum_balas: Option A links the cause (comparing prices) to the consequence (saving money).

soalan: Read: 'Never share your password with anyone when shopping online.' What should you never share online?
maklum_balas: The text says you should never share your password.

soalan: 'The email was a scam designed to trick people into giving their bank details.' The word 'scam' means a _____.
maklum_balas: Tricking people into giving details shows a 'scam' is a dishonest trick.

soalan: Choose the correctly spelled word: 'Shop only on a _____ website to protect your money.'
maklum_balas: The correct spelling is 'secure'.

soalan: Choose the sentence with correct punctuation.
pilihan: Before you buy online, check the seller's reviews.
Before you buy online check the sellers reviews
before you buy online, check the seller's reviews
Before you buy online, check the seller's reviews?
maklum_balas: The sentence needs a comma after the opening clause, an apostrophe in 'seller's', and a full stop.

soalan: Read: 'The online shop offers free delivery for orders above fifty ringgit.' When is delivery free?
maklum_balas: The text states delivery is free for orders above fifty ringgit.

soalan: Read: 'Online shopping is convenient, but it also carries risks. Wise shoppers check reviews, use safe payment methods and never rush a decision.' What is the main idea?
pilihan: Shopping online is convenient but should be done carefully
Online shopping has no risks at all
maklum_balas: The main idea is that online shopping is convenient but requires care.

soalan: 'It is alarming how easily some shoppers hand over their details to unknown websites.' What is the writer's attitude?
maklum_balas: The word 'alarming' shows the writer is concerned.

soalan: Which sentence best explains an advantage of online shopping?
pilihan: You can compare many products from home without travelling to shops
You can never see product reviews online
It always takes longer than visiting a shop
You cannot pay for anything online
maklum_balas: Comparing products from home is a genuine advantage of online shopping.

soalan: 'Watch out for phishing, fake messages that try to steal your personal information.' Based on the context, 'phishing' involves _____.
pilihan: fake messages that steal personal information
maklum_balas: The sentence defines phishing as fake messages used to steal personal information.

soalan: A speaker says: 'Honestly, I no longer trust adverts that promise huge prizes for just one click.' What opinion does the speaker express?
pilihan: He is suspicious of adverts promising big prizes
He has no view on the adverts
maklum_balas: Saying he no longer trusts such adverts shows he is suspicious of them.

soalan: A writer states: 'The best defence against online fraud is not clever software, but a cautious mind.' What is the writer mainly suggesting?
pilihan: Careful thinking protects shoppers better than technology alone
Software is the only protection against fraud
Being cautious online is a waste of time
Online fraud cannot be avoided in any way
maklum_balas: The writer implies a careful, cautious attitude protects shoppers more than software alone.

soalan: In a discussion on safe online shopping, which response best explains and justifies a point of view?
pilihan: Schools should teach online safety because young shoppers are the most likely targets of scams
Schools should teach it just because I said so
Online safety does not matter, though I can't explain why
Teaching online safety is pointless for everyone
maklum_balas: Option A states a view and supports it with a clear justification.

soalan: You are writing a short play about a teenager tricked by an online scam. Which opening line best creates dramatic tension?
pilihan: Aiman stared at the screen, his heart sinking as the words 'Payment Failed' flashed red.
Aiman woke up and had breakfast as usual.
The weather that day was warm and pleasant.
Aiman liked to shop online sometimes.
maklum_balas: Option A uses vivid, tense detail that creates dramatic tension for a short play.
